description:
Follow-up from opi-dkl.5 investigation. `:kill_group` in erlexec
works for single-shot invocations but destabilizes the `:exec`
singleton GenServer when multiple commands run back-to-back —
crashes with `{:exit_status, N}` on the second or third call.

Reproduction: apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/tools/bash_test.exs
with `:kill_group` added to exec_opts, run
`mix test apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/tools/bash_test.exs`.
First test passes; subsequent calls into :exec exit with
`{:exit_status, 1}` or `{:exit_status, 137}`.

Options:
1. File upstream issue against saleyn/erlexec with minimal repro.
2. Write a small custom port helper (~50 LOC of C) that setpgids
   before exec, then use stdlib `Port.open`.
3. Wrap command in `setsid -w` where available; kill via
   `kill -TERM -<pid>` after capturing the sid.

Deferred to Phase 8 polish unless orphan processes become a real
operational issue.
title: Bash process-group kill: custom port helper or erlexec patch
